part.text:
The CLI works end-to-end via `node dist/cli.js build` (equivalent to `npx ssg build` once published/linked).

Built a TypeScript static site generator CLI (`src/parser.ts` for gray-matter + marked parsing, `src/generator.ts` for file discovery/writing, `src/templates.ts` for HTML rendering, `src/cli.ts` using commander for the `build` command with `--content`/`--output`). 20 Jest tests across parser/templates/generator/CLI all pass, and a manual smoke test confirmed real markdown → `dist/` output with index.html, per-page HTML, and a stylesheet.
